garold.desc:
Multi-line cross-section on SIAN3 (P1AU9) and UMTC modules (failing
RX Loss of Lock post-baking) to inspect EO and MTL channel
degradation.

Targeted micro-cross-sections to verify TEC module solder attachment
integrity, voiding levels, and substrate bonding.

Precision cross-section analysis across optical assembly interfaces and
internal interconnect integrity for supplier qualification.

Cross-sectioning across high-speed electro-optic channels to inspect die
placement, wirebond/flip-chip interfaces, and trace integrity

Precision backside grinding and layer-by-layer de-processing to expose
internal buried vias and micro-vias without mechanical damage

BGA joint cross-sectioning to isolate thermal cycle fatigue, solder crack
propagation, and intermetallic compound (IMC) growth.

Evaluation of underfill flow uniformity, fillet height, and voiding under large
active dies.

Detailed cross-section across fiber-to-lens alignment structures to
evaluate mechanical shift and thermal drift.

Targeted cross-section on TX/RX active channels to investigate optical
power drop after accelerated environmental stress.

Cross-sectional analysis of gold-tin (AuSn) hermetic seal rings to verify
seam consistency and void-free bonding.

Verification of passive component solder meniscus, wetting angles, and
solder volume compliance on dense PCBA zones.
